name: Gloom Magic
body:
Gloom Magic (Sp)
Source Blood of Shadows pg. 8
A rogue with this talent gains the ability to cast darkness two times per day as a spell-like ability. The darkness created by this ability does not impair the rogue’s vision. The caster level for this ability is equal to the rogue’s level. A rogue must have an Intelligence score of at least 12 and the minor magic rogue talent before choosing this talent.
